entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
FINALLY! I've been on hold for twenty minutes! This is completely unacceptable. I bought this jersey and it's absolutely useless to me.
I'm very sorry for the wait and for the trouble with your order. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

What's the issue?! The issue is it's the wrong size! It's way too tight, I can barely get it on. I need to exchange this piece of junk right now or I'm leaving a one-star review on every website I can find. This is ridiculous!
I understand your frustration, and I want to help get this sorted out for you. Do you have your order number handy so I can look up the purchase?
Ugh, fine. It's VF8675309. You people better fix this. I want a manager if you can't.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series jersey, delivered on October 29th. That was 62 days ago.
Yeah, so? Are you going to help me or just waste my time stating the facts? I want to exchange it.

Of course. I've just double-checked our return policy, and since you're within the 90-day window, I can absolutely process this for you. We can either start an exchange for the correct size or issue a full refund. Which would you prefer?
...Wait, really? You'll just take it back? No hassle?

Yes, absolutely. You're well within the return period. I can email you a prepaid return label right now so you can send the jersey that's too tight back to us, and we can get the right size shipped out for you.
Oh. Uh, wow. Okay, yeah. An exchange would be great. I just need a Large instead of a Medium.

Not a problem at all. I've just initiated the exchange for a size Large. The return label is on its way to your email on file. Once our warehouse receives the original item, the new one will ship out. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's... that's everything. Thank you, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
